---
title: "03_augment"
format: html
---
##Load libraries and read data
```{r}
library(tidyverse)

expr <- read_tsv("../data/02_clean_expression.tsv")
meta <- read_tsv("../data/02_clean_metadata.tsv")
```

##Transpose the expression dataframe so columns become entrez IDs and rows become samples
```{r}
expr_transposed <- expr |>
  select(-SYMBOL)  |>            #symbol column is droped
  pivot_longer(-ENTREZ_ID, names_to = "sample_id", values_to = "expr") |> 
  pivot_wider(names_from = ENTREZ_ID, values_from = expr)
```

##Inner join expression to meta dataset into a combined wide dataset
```{r}
dat_aug <- meta |> 
  inner_join(expr_transposed, by = "sample_id")

dim(dat_aug)
slice_sample(dat_aug,n=10)
```
##Write the dat_aug into a tsv file
```{r}
write_tsv(dat_aug, here("data", "03_augmented_data.tsv"))
```
